The '''Landing Beacon''' was a [[portable beacon]] designed for [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]. The beacon would transmit tight-beam comm, [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] or [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] signals to mark out landing zones for supply or troop drops. These beacons were standard equipment for [[Pathfinders/Legends|Pathfinders]].<ref name="ROE" />
